newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares chalk up gains, stay in range.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares chalk up gains, stay in range.

text.p: Greek equities chalked up mild gains on Monday on low volume with the market holding its recent trading range. Brokers said a break out to the upside was likely down the road as the macro picture looked favourable.
Tuesday is Greek independence day and a market holiday.

"Despite a prevailing consensus about the positive medium term outlook of the market, stocks are expected to consolidate for a while following thier sharp advance since the beginning of the year," said Telesis Securities.
"Any positive macroeconomic news will improve market sentiment and may trigger a break out from the present trading range in the coming weeks."

The Athens general share index ended 0.50 percent or 6.33 points higher at 1,275.23 points from Friday's 1,268.80 close after opening at 1273.15. Turnover fell to 6.85 billion drachmas on volume of 2.0 million shares.

Advancers led decliners 112 to 73 with 39 issues unchanged on 224 traded. Banks gained 1.41 percent, construction slipped 0.05 percent with industrials settling weaker, down 0.4 percent. Small-caps rose 1.08 percent.
